instruction: How much have I paid in electricity bill on venmo this year so far?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so the goal only demands that the answer (total amount sent for electricity bills since 2023-01-01) has been retrieved and reported via supervisor.complete_task. venmo.show_transactions is modeled once with query='electricity bill', min_created_at=start of year and direction='sent'; at runtime the agent may need to repeat it with page_index to collect all pages and sum the amounts. The supervisor person object is declared for uniformity but carries no predicates; the venmo username is the supervisor's email.
